qa.question: What is the mean of "Ballroom Extravaganza"?
qa.answerHtml: "Ballroom Extravaganza" by DPR IAN is an emotive song about a relationship that has come to an end. The narrator wishes for the relationship to be "the same again," but realizes it is too late. He describes the moments leading up to and after the breakup, from the moment "the world stopped for you" to the “ballroom extravaganza” that ultimately pulls the narrator in. Even with all of the “king's horsemen and all the king's men,” they could not “put [the relationship] back together again.” The song illustrates the sadness of letting go and coming to terms with a life-altering event.
